items.title: Brokerages back ICICI Bank on strong Q2 earnings, see HDFC Bank recovery ahead
items.description: Brokerages remain optimistic about ICICI Bank's strong earnings and asset quality after the recent quarter. However, HDFC Bank's profit growth was modest, and margins are under pressure, leading to a more cautious outlook. Despite this, both banks have attractive valuations and positive earnings recovery prospects. On Monday, both stocks experienced declines, along with broader market indices. Analysts highlight potential upsides for both banks based on target prices.

items.title: Banking stocks, high oil prices drag Indian markets lower
items.description: Across Asia, markets were mixed, with South Korea rebounding 1.8% from last week's losses amid simmering concerns over excessive investments in artificial intelligence (AI). Taiwan fell 0.6%, while Indonesia tumbled 3.6% following a warning from index provider MSCI that it would downgrade the country from the emerging market basket.

items.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
items.description: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.

items.title: Stock Market Holiday 2026: Is stock market closed today for Dussehra? Check remaining holidays for the year
items.description: A total of 16 stock market holidays have been scheduled for 2026, out of which twelve have already passed. After the Dussehra holiday, trading will remain suspended on three more occasions over the remaining two months of the year.

items.title: ED freezes trading accounts in scam tied to social media
items.description: Last week, the ED's Mumbai Zone conducted searches at 29 premises across six cities-Mumbai, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat and Bhavnagar-under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA). The case relates to R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems and R&B Denims, the agency said. According to the ED, the two companies issued more than 35 million shares and convertible warrants through preferential allotments between April 2023 and March 2024. A substantial portion of the funds allegedly came from a small network of connected individuals, firms and lenders, it said.

items.title: NSE, BSE to hold Diwali Muhurat trading on November 8
items.description: According to circulars issued by the NSE, the special trading session will begin at 2:20 pm on Sunday. Continuous trading in stocks covered by the closing auction session (CAS) will end at 3:15 pm, followed by the closing auction, while trading in other stocks will continue until 3:30 pm. Equity futures and options trading will run from 2:20 pm to 3:40 pm.

items.title: Fertiliser stocks: Combination of strong headwinds and structural repair. Who will win? 9 stocks, 4 with upside potential of up to 31%
items.description: For the better part of a decade now, every time this critical sector has run into trouble, the government has stepped in. The clean-up began with small steps. The mandatory coating of urea with neem was an early one. It was a measure that was not financial on the face of it; but it changed the sector’s economics by stopping the diversion of subsidised fertiliser to other uses.

items.title: Jio IPO opens tomorrow: How can investors maximise allotment chances under Rs 2,500 crore RIL shareholders quota
items.description: The much-anticipated Reliance Jio Platforms IPO is launching for public subscription starting October 21, 2023. Shareholders of Reliance Industries can benefit from a Rs 2,500 crore reservation aimed at maximizing their investment opportunities. Those eligible are encouraged to apply in both the shareholder and retail categories. Shares are priced between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119, with allotments set for October 26 and listings on October 28.

items.title: Mukul Agrawal portfolio: Ace investor adds 7 new equity stocks in Q2. Do you own any?
items.description: Ace investor Mukul Mahavir Agrawal is known for his investment strategy, which has generated multibagger returns from several stocks. He publicly holds 77 stocks with a net worth of nearly Rs 8,515 crore, according to Trendlyne data. Here are 7 stocks he likely added to his secondary market portfolio during the second quarter of FY27. With shareholding disclosures still being released, further changes to his portfolio cannot be ruled out.

items.title: WhatsApp stock tips: Nithin Kamath warns of more pump-and-dump schemes as ED freezes accounts worth Rs 200 crore
items.description: In a post on X, formerly Twitter, Kamath said such schemes remain a concern even in 2026, calling them one of the silliest ways for investors to lose money. He also warned that these cases could become more frequent as the market cycle advances, pointing to a rise in alleged pump-and-dump schemes operating through WhatsApp groups and influencers promoting stocks and initial public offerings (IPOs).
